_about: Player abilities: what the spell bar and spellbook show, and the numbers each one runs on. Abilities with a `kind` are spells run by the generic spell engine (src/systems/spells.js): cast, dot, instant, aoe, cleave, burst, charge, buff or camp; the rest have their own code. `cost` is what an ability spends ({mana: n} or {resolve: n}, the class gauge); `gain` is what it gives.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.desc: Auto attack. Right-click an enemy (RT on a pad), or use any ability on it, and you swing at it each time your weapon is ready while it is in reach, until it falls or you pick another. Time between swings = weapon speed ÷ (1 + haste). The blow lands at the swing's impact frame, and only if the target is still in reach then. Dual wielding, each hand swings on its own clock at its weapon's speed; the off hand does half damage and never lands within 0.2 s of the main hand. Not on the spell bar.

abilities.name: Shield Break
abilities.desc: Slam your shield down: strikes every enemy around you, knocks them back and interrupts ordinary attacks. Triggers the global cooldown. 4 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.desc: Charge at your target (or towards the cursor) and strike on arrival. Triggers the global cooldown. 8 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.desc: Raise your shield: the next blow within 2.5 seconds, even a Grave Slam, is turned aside. Off the global cooldown. 7 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Healing draught
abilities.desc: Drink a healing draught from your bags.

abilities.name: Hallowed Bolt
abilities.desc: Call down the old road's light on your target: a 1.6 second cast that hurls a bolt of holy fire. Moving interrupts the cast. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.desc: Tear open your target's wounds. They bleed for 5 ticks over 10 seconds; using it again refreshes the bleed. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.desc: An instant flash of holy light on your target. Triggers the global cooldown. 6 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Hallowed Ground
abilities.desc: Consecrate the ground around you. Every enemy standing in it burns each second for 6 seconds. Triggers the global cooldown. 15 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.desc: A wide swing that hits up to 4 enemies in front of you. Triggers the global cooldown. 5 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.desc: A shout that steels you: all your damage is increased by 20% for 15 seconds. Triggers the global cooldown. 45 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Set Camp
abilities.desc: Spend 3 seconds pitching a camp where you stand. Your spirit rises there if you fall, and resting beside it builds rested experience. Not with enemies close by. Moving interrupts it.

abilities.name: Fishing
abilities.desc: Cast your line into water you are facing. When the bob dips, click it (or press E / A) to strike. Needs a fishing rod in your bags.

abilities.name: Rebuke
abilities.desc: A word of command that breaks your target's spell or aimed shot, and stops it starting another for 3 seconds. Some attacks cannot be interrupted. Off the global cooldown. 10 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Cooking
abilities.desc: Open your cookbook: the recipes you know, what each needs and how many you can make. Cooking needs a fire close by: your camp or the inn's hearth.
